source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Record the serial number, model, and type of the appliance.
3. Specify the date and time of the test.
4. Document the name and qualifications of the tester.
5. Note the location where the test was performed.
6. Detail the procedure used for testing: reference to testing standard (e.g., AS/NZS 3760, BS 7671), testing instrument details.
7. List all visual inspection findings before testing.
8. Record all test results in detail, including numbers and readings—pass/fail status for each test.
9. Describe specifically why the appliance failed.
10. Document any damage, defects, or signs of misuse found during testing.
11. Specify the recommended actions, such as repairs, replacement, return for servicing etc.
12. Indicate what steps are to be taken with the failed appliance (e.g., quarantine, remove power, tag the device).
13. Attach any relevant photos, diagrams
